title: In handleAudioEffectBroadcast of MusicFxHelper.java, there is a possible permission bypass due to a… (CVE-2026-58965)
description: CVE-2026-58965 is a high-severity vulnerability in the handleAudioEffectBroadcast function of MusicFxHelper.java. It involves a possible permission bypass caused by a confused deputy issue, allowing local privilege escalation without requiring additional execution privileges or user interaction.
